summary: Linder tower in Beltrami Island State Forest, moved there in 1953 from a Game & Fish site; a survey of Beltrami County towers lists it standing and dates the original to about 1925.

notes_for_editor: The history rests on one detailed survey PDF of Beltrami County towers on Wikimedia Commons; its author is not named and it has no date. Wikidata and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list only confirm the location and standing status. No staffing, fire or access source was found. Two guessed NHLR URLs returned 404 and the firelookout list shows no NHLR number, so the tower may not be registered. Access and visit fields were omitted because no source says whether climbing is allowed; the brief's access 'unknown' stands. Coordinates differ slightly: the brief and firelookout list give lon -95.27798; Wikidata gives 95 deg 16 min 40.09 sec W (about -95.27780); the survey gives -95.2779. Lat 48.33153 vs survey 48.3316. The gap is about 15 m, so no correction is proposed. Elevation 377 m (1,237 ft) from Wikidata matches the brief. The survey row lists height 80 with type Ladder. No photos added: the Commons file Linder Fire Tower.jpg exists but its license was not checked.
